GalvanicField.description: Whenever <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Actus</style> <style="Repairing">repairs</style> another unit, that unit immediately attacks a target in range, dealing <style="Stat">{[dmgPct]}%</style> of its own <style="Stat_Damage">Damage</style> to a maximum of <style="Stat_Damage">{[maxDmg]} Damage</style> per <style="Stat_Hits">hit</style>. <style="Faction_AdeptusMechanicus">Actus</style> can <style="Repairing">repair</style> other friendly units even if they are at full <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>.
